name: ORION
description: ORION is a challenging benchmark focused on open-web reasoning over long-tail entities, covering both English and Chinese, designed to rigorously evaluate deep reasoning abilities in web-augmented large language models.
reputation: A newer benchmark that has attracted interest for web-augmented reasoning, but it is not yet as established or widely used as long-running general knowledge benchmarks.
notes: Benchmark supports evaluation of multi-agent frameworks for deep search in LLMs over open web data.
